name: dayweave
description: Safely inspect a DayWeave schedule and submit planning proposals for review.

interface.shortDescription: Review schedules and draft safe planning proposals.
interface.longDescription: Read your DayWeave schedule, explore what-if plans, and send proposed tasks, habits, routines, goals, constraints, events, or schedules to the Suggestions Inbox. The plugin never applies changes directly.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my DayWeave schedule and help me draft a proposal for the Suggestions Inbox.
